infoWeCollect: Google Sign-In: We collect your email & UID. No passwords are stored.
Alias & Password: You choose a nickname. Optional password stored locally only.
Posts & Stories: Text-only, fully E2EE. We cannot read or moderate your content.
Reactions: Like 👍, Support 🤝, Us by Us 🫂 — one reaction per user per post.
Analytics: Only crash and usage stats. No tracking or profiling.
privacyPolicy.dataProtection: Your posts are encrypted on your device using AES-256 before uploading. We never see the unencrypted content.
notCollected: No photos, videos, or media uploads
No access to contacts or messages
privacyPolicy.dataSharing: We don't sell or share your data. Firebase only stores encrypted blobs — not readable by anyone.
privacyPolicy.dataRetention: Posts stay until you delete them. Stories disappear in 24 hours. Lost keys = lost content forever.
privacyPolicy.updates: We’ll notify you if we make significant changes to this policy via in-app message or email.

terms.eligibility: Must be 13+ to use Confess. If under 18, you must have parental permission.
terms.identityRules: Alias is mandatory. Don’t impersonate others or use offensive names.
terms.reactionsOnly: No comments. You can only react once per post with: 👍 Like, 🤝 Support, or 🫂 Us by Us.
terms.stories: Stories are temporary, encrypted, and expire after 24 hours. No comments or reactions allowed.
terms.moderation: We can’t read posts due to encryption. Basic word filtering may occur locally during input. Metadata may be reviewed if abuse is reported.
terms.accountBan: We can ban accounts that misuse the platform, react abusively, or break content rules.
terms.limitationOfLiability: We provide the app “as-is”. We're not responsible for outcomes of how users use or interpret others’ posts.
terms.mentalHealthNotice: This app is not medical advice. If you or someone you know is struggling, contact a licensed professional or emergency services.
terms.legalJurisdiction: These terms are governed by the laws of India. Legal disputes will be handled in the courts of New Delhi, India.

infoWeCollect: App Configuration: We store registered app names and paths locally on your device.
Receiver Code: A unique 10-digit code used for secure pairing with the controller app.
Connection Data: Basic connection logs for WebSocket pairing (no personal identifiers).
Settings: Startup preferences and user toggles are stored locally in AppData.
Crash Logs: Anonymous error traces may be collected to improve reliability.
privacyPolicy.dataProtection: All local files are stored securely in your system’s AppData directory. No external databases or third-party APIs have access to your data. WebSocket connections are encrypted using TLS (wss://).
notCollected: No name, email, or personal profile
No access to contacts, camera, or files outside registered apps
privacyPolicy.dataSharing: Linkium does not sell, share, or transmit user data to any third party. The remote WebSocket server only receives your pairing code for connection management — no local file or system data is transmitted.
privacyPolicy.dataRetention: All configuration and pairing data remain on your device until manually deleted or when you uninstall the app. We do not retain any user data on our servers.
yourRights: View and manage all locally stored data
Delete your local configuration and app list anytime
Regenerate your receiver code for security
Disable background or startup operation at any time
privacyPolicy.updates: Any significant changes to our privacy practices will be notified through the GitHub release notes or official website linkium.space.

terms.eligibility: You must be 13 years or older to use Linkium. If under 18, parental guidance is recommended.
terms.identityRules: No personal account or sign-in is required. The receiver code uniquely identifies your device within the pairing system.
usageRules: Do not use Linkium for unauthorized remote control or malicious actions.
Do not distribute your receiver code publicly.
Do not modify or reverse-engineer the software.
terms.systemBehavior: When closed, Linkium minimizes to the system tray and continues running in the background until you exit from the tray menu.
terms.networkUsage: Linkium connects securely to wss://steamdeck.onrender.com only for pairing and command exchange. No other external services are contacted.
terms.moderation: Since Linkium handles only device-level actions, there is no user-generated content to moderate. Security events may be logged locally.
terms.accountBan: Linkium does not operate accounts or cloud profiles. However, misuse or abuse of the SteamDeck network may result in connection blocking.
terms.limitationOfLiability: Linkium is provided 'as-is'. The developer assumes no responsibility for damages, data loss, or system errors resulting from improper use.
terms.softwareLicense: This software is open-source under the MIT License. You are free to use, modify, or distribute it with attribution.
terms.legalJurisdiction: This software is governed by the laws of India. Any legal disputes shall be handled in the courts of New Delhi, India.
